d:
Katihar pulis lain men ek shakhs 12 dinon tak khud ko puliskarmi batakar raha. dayal 112 ka draivar aur esaepi javan batane vale is shakhs ke pas se pharji aaeekard, vardi aur pulis ki vardi men khinchvae gae photo baramad hue. aakhir pulis lain men uski entri kaise huee aur vahan rahne ke pichhe uska maksad kya tha? dekhie puri riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
